summary.text: Peter Schmidt is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 14 who has served in the House since 2002, according to Ballotpedia, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a former university instructor and U.S. Marine Corps veteran.

paragraphs.text: Schmidt graduated from Campion High School and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1956 to 1958.
He earned a B.A. from Northern Illinois University in 1968 and an M.A. from Northwestern University in 1969, and his career experience includes working as a university instructor.
Schmidt served on the Executive Departments and Administration Committee in each session from 2011 through 2024 and on the Administrative Rules Committee in 2021-2022.
Ballotpedia notes that he introduced legislation that would allow non-citizens who have applied for legal immigration status to qualify for in-state tuition at the University System of New Hampshire.
He won election in Strafford 19 in 2020 and in Strafford 14 in 2022, defeated Elliot Ross Boutin in 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
